title: Inverse degree of the Gamma-zero permutation quadrinomials
summary: Determine the exact algebraic degree of the inverse throughout the admissible Gamma-zero permutation-quadrinomial family, including whether it always equals half the extension degree.

formal_statement.body: Let $m$ and $k$ be odd with $\gcd(m,k)=1$, and let $f_{\mathbf c}$ be an admissible permutation quadrinomial over $\mathbb F_{2^{2m}}$ with $\mathbf c\in\Gamma_0$ as defined by the source. Determine $\deg(f_{\mathbf c}^{-1})$ for every admissible parameter tuple. In particular, prove or refute $$\deg(f_{\mathbf c}^{-1})=m.$$

scope.domain: Inverses of the source-defined Gamma-zero permutation quadrinomials over $\mathbb F_{2^{2m}}$
assumptions: $f_{\mathbf c}$ is the source-defined permutation quadrinomial
scope.unresolved_remainder: Give and prove the exact inverse degree for every admissible member, or exhibit and classify every exception to degree m.
